allow_instructions: Allow builds, unit tests, integration tests, typecheck, and local Docker Compose up/build/logs for this gevents repo.
Allow dotnet restore/build/test/ef migrations add, npm install/ci/build/test, and ng build/serve for local development.
Allow reading package.json, lockfiles, and running health checks against localhost.
Allow browser inspection of localhost and already-open Assessoria VIP / Apex tabs for implementation checks.
block_instructions: Block git push --force, git reset --hard, and deleting production data or volumes without human review.
Block deploy to production, Database.Migrate on production, and changes to secrets or billing.
